payload.text: In an opt install, `utilz upgrade` writes nothing and names the republish, `bin/devbin install --force` in the dev checkout, and says when the dev checkout is ahead; in an opt install with an old manifest it refuses, naming the same republish. The other half, that a publish over an existing install is refused without --force, is devbin's publish, and devbin's own arms prove it (devbin#0326).
